drive_thermal_derate.t_stop_note: R-146(a) INTERIM: latch at a 0x22A2 reading >= 82 C (R-142 had 83). NOT valid for G4.
drive_thermal_derate.temp_source_note: primary: 0x22A2:00 UINT16 degC RO mappable in the 1 kHz TxPDO; candidate 0x22A3:1-4 (bench compare vs TI[1] via EAS); fallback 'sdo' 10 Hz round-robin. Object indices owned by Electronics; UNCONFIRMED until bench.
drive_thermal_derate.limit_object_note: 0x6072 Max torque (RxPDO 0x160D/0x1605), per-mille of 0x6075 [bench-verify]; alternative 0x6073 Max current (0x160E). CL[1]/PL[1] stay commissioned: never written, never SV.
drive_thermal_derate.stop_sequence_note: R-146(a) INTERIM (NOT valid for G4): CROUCH (2.0 s derated) -> HOLD_DERATED (derated crouch) -> drive trip -> TUCK, logged as a fall event. Kneel/prone path (R-145/R-146b, D94 MO=0 interlocks) is in code behind kneel_enabled=false.

drive_thermal_derate.safe_stop_zmp_k_note: CoM-xy PD gains (kx, dx) applied ONLY in the kneel/safe-stop moves (R-146b). Global WBC balance gains are unchanged (stock kx 2.5; zmp_k unset outside safe-stop).

knee_shroud.note: convex hull: sloped top z 861.5 (x -20) -> 904 (x -100), 40 deg chamfer on the outboard-top edge, chamfer width 15 mm [EST: ID gives angle + R10, not the width; R10 blend ignored = conservative]; +2 mm skin (T&R). Set chamfer_w 0 / z_top_front = z[1] for a plain box.
